svg.title: Time of one agent run with tracing off and on
svg.desc: Milliseconds per agent run on the Mac, 177 runs per condition. Medians: off 2.59 ms, on 7.56 ms. First runs with tracing on: 170.6, 89.3, 157.6 ms.
svg.text: Each dot is one run of 7 traced runs, 177 per group. The line is the median.
Not drawn: the first run of each process, 170.6, 89.3, 157.6 ms with tracing on.
